name: Publish to three.ws
author: three.ws
description: Saves the incoming GLB into your three.ws account, where it gets a shareable 3D page, an embed, and an AI agent. Humanoid meshes are auto-rigged.

params_schema.label: Name
params_schema.tooltip: Title shown on three.ws. Leave empty to use the file name.

params_schema.label: Visibility
params_schema.tooltip: Who can open the model's page on three.ws. You can change this later from your dashboard.

params_schema.label: API Key
params_schema.tooltip: A three.ws API key with the avatars:write scope (three.ws/dashboard/api). Paste it once: it is saved to your user profile, so you can clear this field before sharing the workflow. The THREE_WS_API_KEY environment variable also works.
